{% assign newsletter_url = site.brevo_form_url | default: "" | strip %}# Anna-Lena Birkner

> Anna-Lena Birkner is a People & Operations Consultant. Anna-Lena works with founders whose growing team still depends on them, and directly with those teams, to clarify responsibilities, agree which decisions people can make and put usable processes in place. Anna-Lena is also available as an Interim HR Business Partner (for example to cover parental or sick leave, an open role or a period of change) and offers team workshops (including responsible AI in hiring), positioning and, with her technical partner DevOpWeb, websites and digital products.

Canonical website: https://annalenabirkner.com/

Working languages: German, English and Spanish.

Working format: Most strategy and build work can happen remotely; Anna-Lena is also available in person when that would be useful. Workshops can be remote or in person by agreement.

Contact: info@annalenabirkner.com

## Start here

- [Team Snapshot](https://annalenabirkner.com/team-snapshot/): A free two-minute self-assessment for teams unsure what is getting in the way. Six questions about how work runs today, with an instant score for each area, practical tips for the weaker areas and a PDF summary to download. {% if newsletter_url != "" %}No sign-up needed: the answers aren’t stored, and nothing leaves the browser unless the visitor chooses to join the optional quarterly newsletter offered with the results.{% else %}No sign-up; it runs entirely in the browser and nothing is sent or stored.{% endif %}
- [Free 30-minute orientation call](https://annalenabirkner.com/contact): A free video call of 30 minutes to talk through what is happening and whether there is a useful fit. No preparation needed. The same page has an option to write instead of booking.

## Services and prices

- [Hands-on strategic support](https://annalenabirkner.com/strategic-support/): Practical support for founders and decision-makers who need to understand a problem, create a useful solution, or stay close to organisational change. Three formats:
  - [Clarity Check](https://annalenabirkner.com/strategic-support/#clarity-review): {{ site.data.offer_prices.clarity_check.en }} for one defined challenge: a focused video conversation, a review of the documents, processes and responsibilities involved, a written priority plan, and a follow-up conversation.
  - [Focused Build](https://annalenabirkner.com/strategic-support/#focused-build): {{ site.data.offer_prices.focused_build.en }}, the next step after a Clarity Check. Two weeks with a deeper analysis of people and set-up, two half-day working sessions, written processes and guidelines for up to 3 recurring problems, a prioritised list of everything else found, and a 2–4 hour handover with the teams involved.
  - [Interim HR Business Partner](https://annalenabirkner.com/strategic-support/#interim-hr-business-partner): Experienced People & Culture support close to founders, leaders, decisions and day-to-day work, for example to cover parental or sick leave, an open role or a period of change. Time commitment, duration and fee are agreed on request.
- [Team workshops](https://annalenabirkner.com/team-workshops/): Practical, participatory topic workshops of two to four hours, bookable on their own. From {{ site.data.offer_prices.workshops.en }} for one remote session with up to 12 participants, including a short briefing beforehand, a workbook on the topic and a written recap. Larger groups, in-person sessions and more extensive preparation are quoted separately.

## Workshop topics

- [Algorithmic hiring](https://annalenabirkner.com/workshops): A two-hour interactive workshop on AI in recruitment: how these systems work, bias and discrimination, the EU AI Act and employer responsibility, human oversight and vendor evaluation. No technical background required.
- [Optimising HR operations](https://annalenabirkner.com/team-workshops/#optimizing-hr-operations): Employee experience, process friction, ownership and simpler workflows.
- [Improving internal communications](https://annalenabirkner.com/team-workshops/#internal-communications): How information moves, what different groups need, and sustainable communication habits.

## Selected work

The case studies on the homepage describe Anna-Lena’s role and the purpose of the work, not measured results.

- [Case 01: Mindfulife](https://annalenabirkner.com/#projects): At Mindfulife, a psychology-led meditation and wellbeing company, Anna-Lena leads People & Culture and works closely with the founders: founder partnership (organisational structure, team development and operational priorities), employee lifecycle and people infrastructure (contracts, digital personnel structures, documentation, repeatable workflows).
- [Case 02: Relief Applications](https://annalenabirkner.com/#projects): At Relief Applications, a humanitarian technology company, Anna-Lena worked across business development (including proposal development), project delivery and people operations, and stepped in as interim HR generalist for a distributed team.
- [Case 03: State Street Bank](https://annalenabirkner.com/#projects): At State Street Bank, a global financial services company, Anna-Lena worked on processes across People & Culture, monthly payroll, German employee benefits and pensions, with the aim of making recurring work simpler, more reliable and less manual. Areas: process improvement and automation, the monthly payroll cycle, and the German employee benefits and pension programme.

## Journal: Human in the Loop

- [Journal overview](https://annalenabirkner.com/blog/): Essays by Anna-Lena Birkner on AI, work and society, plus notes on tools, taste, clarity and human judgement. In English.

## Kurzüberblick auf Deutsch

Anna-Lena Birkner ist People & Operations Consultant. Anna-Lena arbeitet mit Gründer:innen, deren wachsendes Team noch stark an ihnen hängt, und direkt mit diesem Team: Sie klärt Verantwortlichkeiten, legt mit allen Beteiligten fest, welche Entscheidungen das Team selbst treffen kann, und baut mit ihnen alltagstaugliche Abläufe auf. Angebote: Clarity Check ({{ site.data.offer_prices.clarity_check.de }}), Focused Build ({{ site.data.offer_prices.focused_build.de }}), Interim HR Business Partner (auf Anfrage) und Team-Workshops (ab {{ site.data.offer_prices.workshops.de }}). Die Leistungsseiten im Detail und das Journal sind auf Englisch.
